summary: Brazil, Colombia and Ethiopia come first, Vietnam at #2 surprises, and Kenya, Jamaica and Costa Rica, famous coffee names, are the traps.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. A casual found 7 (Brazil, Colombia, Ethiopia, Vietnam, Guatemala, Indonesia, Honduras) and lost lives on Kenya (#22), Jamaica, Costa Rica (#17) and Mexico (#12).

FAO 2023 green coffee. Tea countries cost a life (China #15 with its tonnes; Sri Lanka and Japan show no figure, being under the page's 10,000-tonne floor); coffee words (arabica, robusta, kona) are free.
35 producers with a figure: a casual Blitz names about a dozen, so it is no Blitz.
fixes: FAO prints 316,108 tonnes for the Central African Republic (#10 as printed), an estimate dozens of times its exports that no other source backs: left out (free), so Guatemala is #10. A judge should confirm; with it back in, CAR is #10 and Guatemala #11.
